notes.title: My Grandpa's Haunted House is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33017057/790333ded9d21fb050514d8d603107c5284a16b8.png[/img]
Hello everyone,

The wait is over! I am proudly presenting my new 50th title called My Grandpa's Haunted House which is now available on Steam! If you are into 2D Survival horror games then, this might be the game for you.

[h1]Check it out now:[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2870070/My_Grandpas_Haunted_House/


Please give this game a try. Your feedback is valuable to me. So, please let me know if you encounter issues.

There is a huge discount on [b]Indie Horror Games Bundle #2[/b] for celebrating the release of my 50th project called My Grandpa's Haunted House game on Steam and if you would like to purchase multiple horror games at a huge discount then this is your chance.

[h1]Get Indie Horror Games Bundle #2 here:[/h1] https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/33469/Indie_Horror_Games_Bundle_2/

Thanks to everyone who have been supporting me on Steam! Creating and releasing this game on Steam would have never been possible without your support.

I hope you will enjoy the game. Happy Gaming!

Best Regards,
Anamik

notes.title: Update #3 - Fixed Broken Achievements
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I have been getting a lot of requests from you to fix the achievements. I have tested the game myself to some extent and it seems the achievements are fixed. 
Here are the list of broken achievements which are now fixed:

-Got the Rocket Launcher Ammo
-Got 130 Golden Coins!
-Got 180 Golden Coins!
-Got a Red Skull
-Got a Golden Skull
-Discovered a Devil Hand
-Got 105 Golden Coins!
-Satan Badge Item Unlocked
-Secured Ritual Knife
-Got a Golden Cross
-Discovered Devils Spear
-Found Devils Horn

I am sorry for the late update and the inconvenience caused because of that. I hope this will solve the issues for you. If you find any further issue regarding the game please feel free to let me know in the discussions section. Thank you for your patience!

Best Regards,
Anamik

notes.title: Update #2 - Changes in Keyboard Controls
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

As per the suggestions received from the Steam community, I made some changes to the keyboard controls and added new controls scheme in order to improve the player's gameplay experience.

[b]1. Now the player can jump using "Spacebar" in addition to "W" key.[/b]

[b]2. Previously, the player could shoot by pressing "Spacebar" but it has been changed to "Left Mouse Button". [/b]

The problem with using Spacebar was that you had to repeatedly press it in order to shoot the enemies but now, you just have to hold the left mouse button to shoot multiple bullets at once. The New control settings can be viewed in-game under the "Options" section of the game.

XBOX Controller controls will be modified and some bugs will be fixed and I will provide an update soon.

If you have any more suggestions or feedback to improve the game please feel free to share them here or in the discussion section and I will listen to all of you and make changes to the game accordingly.

Thank you for your continuous support! 

Best Regards,
Anamik
